// 게임용 이펙트 시트를 한 번에 내보내고, 프레임 표(C#)를 만든다.
// 실행: node export_all.mjs <TextSlayersNew 경로>
import { loadEffect, renderFrames, save } from "./pixelfx/tools/lib/fxlib.mjs";
import { packSheet } from "./pack.mjs";
import { encodePNG } from "./pixelfx/tools/lib/png.mjs";
import { join, dirname } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { iceSpray, iceDebris, iceStuck } from "./mel_fx.mjs";
import { fireSlash } from "./ern_fx.mjs";
import { ernBuster, flameSlashes, fireTube } from "./ern2_fx.mjs";
import { isoExplosion, isoSlam, isoLanding } from "./iso_fx.mjs";
import { airBoom, iceFall, thrust, pileImpact } from "./vd_fx.mjs";
import { wave, waveDust, darkPillar, spin, smashArc, stealOrb, stealStart, stealFeed } from "./stium_fx.mjs";

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), project = process.argv[2];
const WHITE = ["#303030", "#505050", "#787878", "#a0a0a0", "#c8c8c8", "#e0e0e0", "#f4f4f4", "#ffffff"];
const VOID = ["#12061f", "#2a0f4a", "#4a1d7a", "#6e2fb0", "#9a52e0", "#c48cff", "#e6c8ff", "#ffffff"];

// from~to: 잘라 쓸 초. center: 기준점을 보이는 영역의 가운데로 (머리 위 표시용)
const SPECS = [
  { key: "boom", make: () => isoExplosion(["#4a1712", "#c9281f", "#f2561d", "#ff8a2a", "#ffc23d", "#ffe26b", "#fff3a6", "#ffffff"], ["#4a4452", "#2e2a36"], "isoBoom"), to: 1.15, fps: 20 },
  { key: "boomDark", make: () => isoExplosion(VOID, ["#3a2a52", "#211636"], "isoDark"), to: 1.15, fps: 20 },
  { key: "hit", fx: "impacts/crit-hit", to: 0.6, fps: 20, options: { palette: WHITE } },
  { key: "slam", make: () => isoSlam(["#4a1712", "#c9281f", "#f2561d", "#ff8a2a", "#ffc23d", "#ffe26b", "#fff3a6", "#ffffff"], ["#8a8294", "#5c556a", "#1a1622"], "isoSlam"), to: 1.2, fps: 18 },
  { key: "landing", make: isoLanding, to: 0.9, fps: 18 },
  { key: "iceShatter", fx: "ice/ice-shatter", from: 0.7, to: 1.7, fps: 18 },
  { key: "heal", fx: "holy/heal-aoe", to: 1.4, fps: 14, options: { reach: 34 } },
  { key: "shield", fx: "holy/divine-shield", to: 2.4, fps: 10, options: { palette: WHITE } },
  { key: "buff", fx: "holy/blessing", to: 1.5, fps: 12, options: { palette: WHITE } },
  { key: "stun", fx: "status/stunned", to: 2.0, fps: 12, center: true },
  { key: "cleave", fx: "melee/cleave-reap", to: 1.0, fps: 30 },
  { key: "stiumSpin", make: spin, to: 0.85, fps: 30 },
  { key: "stiumSmash", make: smashArc, to: 0.75, fps: 30 },
  { key: "darkWave", make: wave, to: 0.3, fps: 20 },
  { key: "waveDust", make: waveDust, to: 0.55, fps: 18 },
  { key: "darkPillar", make: darkPillar, to: 0.85, fps: 24 },
  { key: "grasp", fx: "explosions/stium-implosion", to: 0.78, fps: 30, playFps: 42 },
  { key: "darkPulse", fx: "shadow/stium-pulse", from: 0.36, to: 1.66, fps: 24 },
  { key: "stealOrb", make: stealOrb, to: 0.2, fps: 20 },
  { key: "stealStart", make: stealStart, to: 0.45, fps: 24 },
  { key: "stealFeed", make: stealFeed, to: 0.5, fps: 24 },
  { key: "airBoom", make: airBoom, to: 0.95, fps: 24 },
  { key: "iceFall", make: iceFall, to: 1.05, fps: 24 },
  { key: "airBoomBig", make: () => airBoom(1.8, "airBoomBig"), to: 1.15, fps: 22 },
  { key: "pileImpact", make: pileImpact, to: 0.75, fps: 30 },
  { key: "thrust", make: thrust, to: 0.55, fps: 20 },
  { key: "iceSpray", make: iceSpray, to: 0.45, fps: 24 },
  { key: "iceDebris", make: iceDebris, to: 2.6, fps: 12 },
  { key: "iceDebrisB", make: () => iceDebris(77, "iceDebrisB"), to: 2.6, fps: 12 },
  { key: "iceStuck", make: iceStuck, to: 1.0, fps: 10, center: true },
  { key: "lightning", fx: "lightning/lightning-strike", from: 0.55, to: 1.5, fps: 24 },
  { key: "shieldBig", fx: "holy/divine-shield-big", to: 2.4, fps: 10, center: true },
  { key: "cleaveErn", fx: "melee/cleave-ern", to: 0.65, fps: 30 },
  { key: "cleaveMail", fx: "melee/cleave-mail", to: 1.0, fps: 30 },
  { key: "cleaveYowol", fx: "melee/cleave-yowol", to: 0.65, fps: 30 },
  { key: "cleaveLavada", fx: "melee/cleave-lavada", to: 1.0, fps: 30 },
  { key: "cleaveLeon", fx: "melee/cleave-leon", to: 1.0, fps: 30 },
  { key: "cleaveSahara", fx: "melee/cleave-sahara", to: 0.65, fps: 30 },
  { key: "cleaveGaniak", fx: "melee/cleave-ganiak", to: 0.65, fps: 30 },
  { key: "cleaveMomoroi", fx: "melee/cleave-momoroi", to: 1.0, fps: 30 },
  { key: "fireSlash", make: fireSlash, to: 1.05, fps: 24 },
  { key: "fireWide", make: () => fireSlash(-30, 168, 52, "fireWide"), to: 0.95, fps: 24 },
  { key: "ernBuster", make: ernBuster, to: 1.2, fps: 20 },
  { key: "fireTubeBack", make: () => fireTube(false), to: 0.45, fps: 20 },
  { key: "fireTubeFront", make: () => fireTube(true), to: 0.45, fps: 20 },
  { key: "flameSlashes", make: () => flameSlashes(2.1), to: 0.65, fps: 30 },
  { key: "darkSlam", make: () => isoSlam(VOID, ["#7a5aa8", "#4c3378", "#140a22"], "isoDarkSlam"), to: 1.2, fps: 18 },
];

const rows = [], shots = [];
let bytes = 0;
for (const s of SPECS) {
  const fx = s.make ? s.make() : await loadEffect(s.fx);
  const r = renderFrames(fx, { fps: s.fps, bg: "none", actor: false, options: s.options });
  // 불꽃 색은 팔레트를 따르지 않으므로, 따뜻한 색을 보라로 바꾼다
  if (s.violet)
    for (const f of r.frames)
      for (let i = 0; i < f.clear.length; i += 4) {
        const R = f.clear[i], G = f.clear[i + 1], B = f.clear[i + 2];
        if (R > B + 30) { f.clear[i] = Math.round(R * 0.62); f.clear[i + 1] = Math.round(G * 0.3); f.clear[i + 2] = Math.min(255, Math.round(R * 0.95 + G * 0.15)); }
      }
  const first = Math.round((s.from ?? 0) * s.fps);
  const frames = r.frames.slice(first, first + Math.round((s.to - (s.from ?? 0)) * s.fps));
  let x0 = r.w, y0 = r.h, x1 = -1, y1 = -1;
  for (const f of frames)
    for (let y = 0; y < r.h; y++)
      for (let x = 0; x < r.w; x++)
        if (f.clear[(y * r.w + x) * 4 + 3] >= 24) { x0 = Math.min(x0, x); x1 = Math.max(x1, x); y0 = Math.min(y0, y); y1 = Math.max(y1, y); }
  const w = x1 - x0 + 1, h = y1 - y0 + 1;
  const crop = (src) => {
    const d = new Uint8ClampedArray(w * h * 4);
    for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) d.set(src.subarray(((y + y0) * r.w + x0) * 4, ((y + y0) * r.w + x0 + w) * 4), y * w * 4);
    return d;
  };
  const cut = { ...r, w, h, n: frames.length, frames: frames.map((f) => ({ ...f, clear: crop(f.clear), color: crop(f.color) })) };
  const [ox, oy] = fx.meta.origin;
  const px = s.center ? Math.round(w / 2) : ox - x0, py = s.center ? Math.round(h / 2) : oy - y0;
  const sheet = packSheet(cut.frames.map((f) => f.clear), w, h, px, py);   // 프레임마다 빈 곳을 잘라 담는다
  save(join(project, "Assets/Resources/FieldFx", `${s.key}.bytes`), sheet.png);
  bytes += sheet.width * sheet.height * 4;
  console.log(s.key, "frames", cut.n, "sheet", sheet.width, sheet.height);
  rows.push(`            { "${s.key}", new FxSheet(${s.playFps ?? s.fps}f, new short[] { ${sheet.rects.join(", ")} }) },   // ${s.fx ?? "custom"}`);
  shots.push(cut);
}
console.log("texture memory MB", (bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1));

save(join(project, "Assets/Scripts/UI/GameView.FxSheets.Table.cs"), `// 자동 생성: 시트 내보내기 스크립트가 만든 프레임 표. 손으로 고치지 않는다.
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace TextSlayers
{
    public static partial class GameView
    {
        static readonly Dictionary<string, FxSheet> FxSheets = new Dictionary<string, FxSheet>
        {
${rows.join("\n")}
        };
    }
}
`);

// 확인용: 시트마다 프레임 8장
const N = 8, CW = 200, CH = 170, W = N * CW, H = shots.length * CH, img = new Uint8ClampedArray(W * H * 4);
for (let i = 0; i < W * H; i++) img.set([22, 20, 30, 255], i * 4);
shots.forEach((r, row) => {
  for (let k = 0; k < N; k++) {
    const f = r.frames[Math.floor(((k + 0.3) / N) * r.n)];
    for (let y = 0; y < CH; y++) for (let x = 0; x < CW; x++) {
      const sx = x - Math.floor((CW - r.w) / 2), sy = y - Math.floor((CH - r.h) / 2);
      if (sx < 0 || sy < 0 || sx >= r.w || sy >= r.h) continue;
      const s = (sy * r.w + sx) * 4, a = f.clear[s + 3] / 255, d = ((row * CH + y) * W + k * CW + x) * 4;
      for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) img[d + c] = f.clear[s + c] * a + img[d + c] * (1 - a);
    }
  }
});
save(join(here, "fxout", "all.png"), encodePNG(W, H, img));
